title: The Philippines Is Coming For Iron Chef Thailand: Meet The Four Chefs
summary: Four Filipino chefs—AC Agra, Sonny Mariano, Maverick “Mav” Javier and Mia Carla Yan—represent the Philippines on Iron Chef Thailand VS Asia Season 2, premiering on Netflix October 10.
